+-- RMS-1025: Add KPI summary table
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ANALYTICS.PUBLIC.KPI_SUMMARY (
+    ID          NUMBER AUTOINCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
+    METRIC_NAME VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
+    METRIC_VALUE FLOAT,
+    PERIOD_DATE DATE,
+    CREATED_AT  TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
+);

+{{ config(materialized='table') }}
+
+SELECT
+    metric_name,
+    SUM(metric_value) AS total_value,
+    period_date
+FROM {{ ref('raw_metrics') }}
+GROUP BY metric_name, period_date
